## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (security changes demonstrate the prevented failure)
- [ ] `README.md` updated if the public API or config changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under an "Unreleased" / next-version heading
- [ ] No weakening of the security model (PKCE, token hashing, redirect matching, scope normalization, confirm-token ownership) without prior discussion
